source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 30 (PDF 202-216), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 30 (Spectroscopy-2 NMR) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Name four fields, other than chemistry, in which NMR spectroscopy is used.
(Chemistry ke ilawa chaar fields ke naam likhein jahan NMR spectroscopy istemal hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation: NMR polymer industry, proteins aur natural products ke mutaale, environment monitoring aur medical field mein istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: is a powerful technique which is extensively used in chemistry

blocks.prompt:
2 For what purpose is NMR particularly used in chemistry? Name its two common methods.
(Chemistry mein NMR khaas taur par kis maqsad ke liye istemal hoti hai? Is ke do aam methods ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Chemistry mein NMR organic compounds ki pehchaan aur un ki structure maloom karne ke liye istemal hoti hai. Do aam methods proton (¹H) NMR aur carbon-13 (¹³C) NMR hain.

book_ref.quote: this technique is particularly used for the identification of organic compounds

blocks.prompt:
3 On what property is NMR spectroscopy based? Which atoms usually show NMR signals?
(NMR spectroscopy kis property par mabni hai? Kaun se atoms aam taur par NMR signal dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: NMR spectroscopy nuclei ki magnetic properties (nuclear spin) par mabni hai. Odd mass number wale atoms, jaise ¹H aur ¹³C, aam taur par signal dete hain; un ke nuclei chhote magnets ki tarah hote hain.

book_ref.quote: NMR spectroscopy is based on the magnetic properties (nuclear spin) of nuclei

blocks.prompt:
4 What happens to ¹H nuclei when they are placed in a strong magnetic field?
(¹H nuclei ko taqatwar magnetic field mein rakhne par kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Field ke baghair nuclei be-tarteeb rukh mein aur aik jaisi energy ke hote hain. Taqatwar field mein woh field ke saath ya khilaf align ho jate hain, yun do spin states bante hain: low energy aur high energy state.

book_ref.quote: give rise to two spin states i.e., low energy state and high energy state

blocks.prompt:
5 What is spin flipping? How is an NMR spectrum obtained from it?
(Spin flipping kya hai? Is se NMR spectrum kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Radio waves dalne par low energy state ke nuclei energy jazb kar ke high energy state mein chale jate hain; yeh spin flipping hai. Wapas asal state mein aate waqt woh energy kharij karte hain jo detect ho kar NMR spectrum banti hai.

book_ref.quote: and move to higher energy state (spin flipping)

blocks.prompt:
6 What is meant by the molecular environment of a nucleus?
(Nucleus ke molecular environment se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleus ko flip karne ki exact energy us ki compound mein jagah aur ird gird ke atoms par munhasir hai; inhein mil kar molecular environment kehte hain. Is liye NMR aik molecule ke mukhtalif environments ke hydrogens pehchan sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: collectively known as the molecular environment

blocks.prompt:
7 Why do the methyl and hydroxyl hydrogens of methanol absorb different frequencies of radio waves?
(Methanol ke methyl aur hydroxyl hydrogens radio waves ki mukhtalif frequencies kyun jazb karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃OH mein teen hydrogens carbon se aur aik oxygen se jura hai. -CH₃ aur O-H hydrogens mukhtalif environments mein hain, is liye flip hone ke liye mukhtalif energy (mukhtalif frequency) jazb karte hain.

book_ref.quote: so they absorb different amount of energy (different frequency of radio waves) for flipping

blocks.prompt:
8 How can nuclei lying in different environments be flipped by radio waves of the same frequency?
(Mukhtalif environments ke nuclei aik hi frequency ki radio waves se kaise flip ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Agar magnetic field ki taqat badli jaye to mukhtalif environments ke nuclei aik hi frequency ki radio waves se flip ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: if the strength of magnetic field is varied

blocks.prompt:
9 Why does ¹²C have no net magnetic field? Do such nuclei always have equal numbers of protons and neutrons?
(¹²C ka khalis magnetic field kyun nahi hota? Kya aise nuclei mein protons aur neutrons hamesha barabar hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Even atomic aur even mass number wale nuclei mein protons aur neutrons even hote hain; protons apne spins jorr lete hain aur neutrons apne, is liye khalis magnetic field nahi (maslan ¹²C). Tadaad hamesha barabar nahi: ¹⁸O mein 8 protons aur 10 neutrons hain.

book_ref.quote: The protons pair their spins and the neutrons pair theirs

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book mein likha hai ke aise nuclei mein protons aur neutrons barabar hote hain; yeh hamesha sach nahi. Asal wajah spins ka jorra banna (pairing) hai: protons aapas mein aur neutrons aapas mein spin jorr lete hain, is liye ¹²C NMR mein signal nahi deta.

blocks.prompt:
10 Why are ordinary solvents such as CHCl₃ not used in ¹H NMR?
(¹H NMR mein CHCl₃ jaise aam solvents kyun istemal nahi hote?)
blocks.explanation: Sample zyada solvent mein hal kiya jata hai. Aam solvents ke hydrogen atoms taqatwar signals dete hain; maslan CHCl₃ ka aik proton itna taqatwar signal deta ke sample ke kamzor signals chhup jate.

book_ref.quote: Ordinary solvents contain hydrogen atoms which produce strong signals

blocks.prompt:
11 What are deuterated solvents? Give two examples.
(Deuterated solvents kya hain? Do misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Deuterated solvents woh solvents hain jin mein hydrogen (H) ki jagah us ka isotope deuterium (D) ho. Misaalein: CDCl₃ (deuterated chloroform) aur CD₃OD (deuterated methanol).

book_ref.quote: deuterated solvents such as CDCl₃ (deuterated chloroform) or CD₃OD (deuterated methanol), are used

blocks.prompt:
12 Why is CDCl₃ called a 'silent' solvent in ¹H NMR?
(¹H NMR mein CDCl₃ ko 'silent' solvent kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Deuterium ko flip hone ke liye mukhtalif radio frequency chahiye, is liye woh sample wali frequency jazb nahi karta aur ¹H spectrum mein peak nahi deta. Sirf sample ke signals nazar aate hain.

book_ref.quote: This makes the solvent "silent", and only the signals of the sample are observed

blocks.prompt:
13 Define chemical shift. In what unit is it measured?
(Chemical shift ki definition likhein. Yeh kis unit mein napa jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chemical shift (δ) ¹H NMR spectrum mein TMS peak (0.0 ppm) ke muqable mein kisi peak ki jagah hai. Yeh parts per million (ppm) mein napa jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The position of a peak in a ¹H NMR spectrum relative to TMS peak is called the chemical shift

blocks.prompt:
14 What is TMS? What value is assigned to its signal?
(TMS kya hai? Is ke signal ko kya value di jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: TMS tetramethylsilane, Si(CH₃)₄, hai jo NMR ka standard reference compound hai. Is ke signal ko 0.0 ppm diya jata hai aur baqi tamam proton signals isi zero point se nape jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Tetramethylsilane, Si(CH₃)₄ (commonly known as TMS) is used as the standard reference

blocks.prompt:
15 Why does the TMS signal not overlap with most organic proton signals, and why is TMS easy to remove?
(TMS ka signal aksar organic proton signals se kyun nahi milta, aur TMS aasani se kyun nikal jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Silicon ki kam electronegativity ki wajah se TMS protons spectrum ke bilkul daayen aate hain, aksar organic signals se door. TMS chemically inert aur volatile hai, is liye istemal ke baad aasani se nikal jata hai.

book_ref.quote: do not overlap with most organic proton signals

blocks.prompt:
16 What does the chemical shift of a proton indicate?
(Proton ka chemical shift kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chemical shift proton ka electronic environment batata hai. Mukhtalif environments ke protons ke δ mukhtalif aur aik environment walon ke δ aik jaise hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Chemical shift indicates the electronic environment of a proton

blocks.prompt:
17 What are chemically equivalent protons? Name three compounds in which all protons are equivalent.
(Chemically equivalent protons kya hain? Teen aise compounds ke naam likhein jin ke tamam protons equivalent hain.)
blocks.explanation: Molecule mein aik jaise chemical environment wale protons chemically equivalent hain aur un ka chemical shift aik hota hai. Methane, ethane aur benzene (aur TMS, propanone) ke tamam protons equivalent hain, is liye har aik aik peak deta hai.

book_ref.quote: All the protons (¹H) found in chemically identical environments within a molecule are chemically equivalent

blocks.prompt:
18 How many proton environments does ethanol (C₂H₅OH) have? Name them.
(Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) mein protons ke kitne environments hain? Un ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ethanol mein protons ke teen environments hain: -CH₃ ke teen protons (aik), -CH₂- ke do protons (doosra) aur O-H proton (teesra).

book_ref.quote: all the three protons of -CH₃ have same environment, while the two protons of -CH₂- have same environment

blocks.prompt:
19 How does electron density around a proton affect its chemical shift?
(Proton ke ird gird electron density us ke chemical shift par kya asar dalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada electron density (alkyl groups) wale protons ka δ kam hota hai. Kam electron density wale protons, jo F, O, N, Cl jaise electronegative atoms ke qareeb hon, zyada δ par aate hain.

book_ref.quote: The chemical shift of a proton (¹H) is affected by the electron density of its surrounding chemical environment

blocks.prompt:
20 Give reason: in methanol the O-H proton (4.80 ppm) appears at a higher δ than the CH₃ protons (3.35 ppm).
(Wajah batayein: methanol mein O-H proton (4.80 ppm) CH₃ protons (3.35 ppm) se zyada δ par aata hai.)
blocks.explanation: CH₃ protons ke ird gird electron density zyada hai, is liye 3.35 ppm par aate hain. O-H proton electronegative oxygen ke saath hai jo us ki electron density kam karta hai, is liye zyada value 4.80 ppm par aata hai.

book_ref.quote: which appears at 4.80 ppm due to the presence of electronegative oxygen next to it

blocks.prompt:
21 What is the chemical shift range of a ¹H NMR spectrum, and how is Table 30.1 useful?
(¹H NMR spectrum ki chemical shift range kya hai, aur Table 30.1 kis kaam aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: ¹H NMR spectrum ki δ range 0 – 12 ppm hai. Table 30.1 mukhtalif proton environments ki chemical shift ranges deta hai, jo na-maloom compound ke spectrum mein protons ka environment pehchanne aur predict karne mein madad karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This data table is helpful in identifying and predicting the environment of protons

blocks.prompt:
22 Using Table 30.1, give the δ ranges for (i) CH₃–Cl protons and (ii) an aldehyde proton.
(Table 30.1 se δ ranges likhein: (i) CH₃–Cl protons aur (ii) aldehyde proton.)
blocks.explanation: (i) CH₃–Cl electronegative atom ke saath alkyl hai: 3.0 – 4.5 ppm. (ii) Aldehyde proton (RCHO): 9.0 – 10.0 ppm.

book_ref.quote: Alkyl next to electronegative atom (halogenoalkanes, alcohols)

blocks.prompt:
23 Distinguish between the δ ranges of alkyl protons in alkanes and aromatic (Ar–H) protons.
(Alkanes ke alkyl protons aur aromatic (Ar–H) protons ki δ ranges mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: In ki electron density aur spectrum mein jagah mukhtalif hai:

book_ref.quote: Table 30.1 Chemical shifts of some common types of protons

rows: Kam δ, zyada electron density (alkyl group)

blocks.prompt:
24 Which three parameters are analysed while interpreting a low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum?
(Low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum ko samajhte waqt kaun se teen parameters dekhe jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: (1) Peaks ki kul tadaad, jo protons ke environments ki tadaad batati hai; (2) har peak ki jagah (chemical shift δ), jo environment ki qisam batati hai; (3) har peak ke neeche area, jo protons ki nisbati tadaad batata hai.

book_ref.quote: three parameters are carefully analysed; total number of peaks in the spectrum

blocks.prompt:
25 What does the number of peaks in a ¹H NMR spectrum tell us? Give the example of ethanol.
(¹H NMR spectrum mein peaks ki tadaad kya batati hai? Ethanol ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Har peak aik mukhtalif chemical environment hai, is liye peaks ki tadaad protons ke environments ke barabar hai. Ethanol teen peaks deta hai: CH₃, CH₂ aur OH protons.

book_ref.quote: Each peak in the spectrum stands for a different chemical environment.

blocks.prompt:
26 Assign the three peaks (5.4, 3.7 and 1.2 ppm) in the low-resolution spectrum of ethanol.
(Ethanol ke low-resolution spectrum ki teen peaks (5.4, 3.7 aur 1.2 ppm) ki pehchaan karein.)
blocks.explanation: 5.4 ppm: OH proton (kam electron density); 3.7 ppm: oxygen ke saath –CH₂–; 1.2 ppm: –CH₃ protons.

book_ref.quote: In the spectrum of ethanol (Figure 30.4), the peak at 5.4 ppm represents

blocks.prompt:
27 A compound C₄H₈O₂ gives three peaks with relative areas 4.5 : 3.0 : 4.5. Find the number of protons in each environment.
(Compound C₄H₈O₂ teen peaks deta hai jin ke nisbati areas 4.5 : 3.0 : 4.5 hain. Har environment mein protons ki tadaad maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Sab se chhote area se taqseem: 4.5/3.0 : 3.0/3.0 : 4.5/3.0 = 1.5 : 1 : 1.5 = 3 : 2 : 3. Majmooa = 8 = C₄H₈O₂ ke 8 H, is liye peaks 3 H, 2 H aur 3 H ki hain.

book_ref.quote: The area under each peak is proportional to the number of protons giving rise to that peak.

blocks.prompt:
28 How can the total number of hydrogen atoms in a molecule be found from its ¹H NMR spectrum?
(¹H NMR spectrum se molecule mein hydrogen atoms ki kul tadaad kaise maloom hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peak areas har environment ke protons batate hain; inhein jama karne se kul tadaad milti hai. Ethanol ke liye 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 hydrogen atoms.

book_ref.quote: The sum of number of each type of protons gives the total number of protons present in the molecule

blocks.text: 30.4.2 High-Resolution 1H NMR and Splitting of Peaks

blocks.prompt:
29 Why does a peak in a high-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum appear as a cluster of sub-peaks?
(High-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum mein peak sub-peaks ka guchha kyun nazar aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: NMR signals sirf qareeb ke electrons se nahi balke saath wale atoms ke protons se bhi mutasir hote hain. Har signal saath wale carbon atoms ke protons se split hota hai, is liye peak sub-peaks ka guchha nazar aati hai.

book_ref.quote: The NMR signals of protons are not only affected by the nearby electrons

blocks.prompt:
30 State the n+1 rule.
(n+1 rule bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Signal aam taur par n + 1 sub-peaks mein split hota hai, jahan n saath wale carbon atom(s) par protons ki tadaad hai. Sub-peaks = n + 1.

book_ref.quote: A signal usually splits into n+1 sub-peaks

blocks.prompt:
31 Explain the splitting of the -CH₃ and -CH₂- signals in the high-resolution spectrum of ethanol.
(Ethanol ke high-resolution spectrum mein -CH₃ aur -CH₂- signals ki splitting samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: -CH₃: saath wale carbon par 2 protons, is liye 2 + 1 = 3 sub-peaks (triplet). -CH₂-: saath wale carbon par 3 protons, is liye 3 + 1 = 4 sub-peaks (quartet).

book_ref.quote: because the number of protons on adjacent carbon is 2 (2+1=3)

blocks.prompt:
32 Give reason: the -OH signal of ethanol is not split.
(Wajah batayein: ethanol ka -OH signal split nahi hota.)
blocks.explanation: Us ka hydrogen carbon ki bajaye oxygen atom se jura hai. -OH aur -NH protons aam taur par split nahi hote aur singlet ki shakal mein aate hain.

book_ref.quote: The -OH signal is not split because hydrogen is bonded to an oxygen atom

blocks.prompt:
33 Why does ethane give a single unsplit peak although each CH₃ has 3 protons on the adjacent carbon?
(Ethane aik be-split peak kyun deta hai halan ke har CH₃ ke saath wale carbon par 3 protons hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chemically equivalent protons apne parosi protons ko split nahi karte. Ethane ke chhe hydrogens equivalent hain, is liye us ki peak singlet hai.

book_ref.quote: However, the peak does not show splitting because all the hydrogen atoms in ethane are chemically equivalent

blocks.prompt:
34 Name the splitting patterns for n = 0, 1, 2 and 3 with their abbreviations.
(n = 0, 1, 2 aur 3 ke liye splitting patterns ke naam abbreviations ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: n = 0: 1 sub-peak, singlet (s); n = 1: 2 sub-peaks, doublet (d); n = 2: 3 sub-peaks, triplet (t); n = 3: 4 sub-peaks, quartet (q).

book_ref.quote: is useful to recognise splitting patterns in high-resolution ¹H NMR spectra

blocks.prompt:
35 Predict the splitting of the CH₃ and CHO signals of ethanal (CH₃CHO).
(Ethanal (CH₃CHO) ke CH₃ aur CHO signals ki splitting predict karein.)
blocks.explanation: CH₃: saath wale carbon par 1 proton, 1 + 1 = 2 sub-peaks (doublet). CHO: saath wale carbon par 3 protons, 3 + 1 = 4 sub-peaks (quartet).

book_ref.quote: This is due to the splitting of each signal due to the presence of protons (¹H) on adjacent carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
36 Differentiate between low-resolution and high-resolution ¹H NMR spectra.
(Low-resolution aur high-resolution ¹H NMR spectra mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein farq yeh hai ke peak kitni tafseel dikhati hai:

book_ref.quote: This effect can be observed by a high-resolution NMR

rows: Har environment aik peak deta hai
Har peak aksar sub-peaks ka guchha hoti hai
Har environment ki tadaad, qisam aur protons ki nisbati tadaad
Saath wale carbon ke protons ka asar bhi dikhata hai
Splitting (n+1 rule) parosi protons ki tadaad batati hai

blocks.text: 30.4.3 Identifying O-H and N-H Protons by D2O Exchange

blocks.prompt:
37 Why do O-H and N-H protons show a wide range of chemical shift? Write the exchange of ethanol with water.
(O-H aur N-H protons ke chemical shift ki range wasee kyun hoti hai? Ethanol ka paani se exchange likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
O-H (alcohols, acids) aur N-H (amines, amides) ke hydrogens aasani se badal jate hain, is liye un ke singlet ka δ wasee range mein hota hai.
CH₃–CH₂–O–Hᵃ + Hᵇ–O–Hᵇ ⇌ CH₃–CH₂–O–Hᵇ + Hᵃ–O–Hᵇ

book_ref.quote: The hydrogen atoms in O-H (alcohols or carboxylic acids) and N-H (amines or amides) are easily exchangeable

blocks.prompt:
38 Give reason: in the D₂O shake, only the O-H and N-H peaks disappear, not the C-H peaks.
(Wajah batayein: D₂O shake mein sirf O-H aur N-H peaks ghayab hoti hain, C-H peaks nahi.)
blocks.explanation: O ya N jaise zyada electronegative atoms se jure protons aasani se deuterium se badal jate hain (R–O–H + D₂O ⇌ R–O–D + HOD) aur D ¹H peak nahi deta. Carbon wale protons nahi badalte, is liye un ki peaks rehti hain.

book_ref.quote: When D₂O is added to the sample solution, these hydrogens are quickly exchanged with the deuterium (D) atoms

blocks.prompt:
39 Why is a deuterium atom 'invisible' in a ¹H NMR spectrum?
(¹H NMR spectrum mein deuterium atom 'invisible' kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Deuterium ko spin flip ke liye ¹H se mukhtalif energy chahiye, is liye woh ¹H NMR spectrum mein peak nahi deta.

book_ref.quote: As deuterium atom requires different energy for spin flipping as compared to ¹H

blocks.prompt:
40 An amine shows a singlet whose identity is doubtful. How does comparing two spectra confirm that it is an N-H peak?
(Aik amine ka singlet mashkook hai. Do spectra ka muqabla kaise sabit karta hai ke yeh N-H peak hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehla spectrum N-H samet tamam H atoms dikhata hai. D₂O ke chand qatre daal kar hilane ke baad spectrum dobara liya jata hai; agar woh singlet ghayab ho gaya to woh N-H proton ka tha.

book_ref.quote: Comparing both spectra confirms the identity of the peak arising due to N-H or O-H

blocks.text: 30.5 Predicting the 1H NMR Spectrum of a Given Molecule

blocks.prompt:
41 List the four steps for predicting the ¹H NMR spectrum of a given molecule.
(Kisi molecule ka ¹H NMR spectrum predict karne ke chaar qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: I: protons ke mukhtalif environments pehchanein (= peaks ki tadaad). II: Table 30.1 se har set ka δ andaza lagayein. III: n+1 rule se har peak ki splitting predict karein. IV: har environment ke H ki tadaad se integration ratios dein.

book_ref.quote: This can be done in the following steps:

blocks.prompt:
42 Without a data table, how would you decide which proton set in a molecule has the higher δ?
(Data table ke baghair kaise faisla karein ge ke molecule mein kis proton set ka δ zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Qareeb ke bonds aur atoms dekhein: electronegative elements ke qareeb protons ka δ zyada aur alkyl groups ke protons ka δ aam taur par kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The protons near electronegative elements have higher chemical shift (δ)

blocks.prompt:
43 Predict the number of peaks, splitting and area ratio in the ¹H NMR spectrum of bromoethane (CH₃CH₂Br).
(Bromoethane (CH₃CH₂Br) ke ¹H NMR spectrum mein peaks, splitting aur area ratio predict karein.)
blocks.explanation: Do environments, is liye do peaks. CH₂ (Br ke saath) zyada δ, 3.0 – 4.5 ppm, quartet (3 + 1); CH₃ 0.5 – 1.5 ppm, triplet (2 + 1). Area ratio CH₃ : CH₂ = 3 : 2.

book_ref.quote: -CH₂- signal will split into a quartet.

blocks.prompt:
44 Predict the ¹H NMR spectrum of methoxymethane (CH₃–O–CH₃).
(Methoxymethane (CH₃–O–CH₃) ka ¹H NMR spectrum predict karein.)
blocks.explanation: Chhe protons equivalent (aik environment), is liye aik peak. Yeh CH₃–O hai, is liye δ 3.0 – 4.5 ppm. Parosi O hai (protons nahi), n = 0: 6 H ka singlet.

book_ref.quote: Step II: Estimate the chemical shift (δ) for each set of protons having same chemical environment

blocks.text: 30.6 Determining the Possible Structure of a Molecule from 1H NMR

blocks.prompt:
45 Which pieces of information are combined to deduce a structure from a ¹H NMR spectrum?
(¹H NMR spectrum se structure nikalne ke liye kaun si maloomaat jori jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Peaks ki tadaad (environments), har peak ka chemical shift (functional groups), peak areas (har environment ke H) aur splitting (n = sub-peaks – 1, parosi protons). Inhein jorr kar structure banti hai.

book_ref.quote: It can be done by putting together the following key pieces of information like a puzzle

blocks.prompt:
46 Give reason: the number of peaks in a ¹H NMR spectrum is not the number of protons in the molecule.
(Wajah batayein: ¹H NMR spectrum mein peaks ki tadaad molecule ke protons ki tadaad nahi.)
blocks.explanation: Equivalent protons mil kar aik peak dete hain, is liye har peak equivalent protons ka aik set (environment) hai. Har set ke protons peak areas se maloom hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The number of peaks equals the number of proton environments (sets of equivalent protons), not the number of protons

blocks.prompt:
47 In Example 30.2, why is the peak at 2.2 ppm (3H) a singlet, and what does it show?
(Example 30.2 mein 2.2 ppm (3H) wali peak singlet kyun hai, aur yeh kya batati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Singlet ka matlab n = 1 – 1 = 0 parosi protons. 2.2 ppm C=O ke saath alkyl ki range mein hai, is liye yeh C=O carbon se jura CH₃ (CH₃–C=O) hai.

book_ref.quote: The ¹H NMR spectrum of an ester is given below. Deduce the structure of the ester.

blocks.prompt:
48 In Example 30.2, what is the splitting of the CH₂ signal at 3.9 ppm and why?
(Example 30.2 mein 3.9 ppm wale CH₂ signal ki splitting kya hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh quartet hai: O ke saath wale CH₂ ka parosi CH₃ group (3 protons) hai, is liye 3 + 1 = 4 sub-peaks, yani n = 4 – 1 = 3.

book_ref.quote: The CH₂ next to O has three neighbouring protons (the CH₃ group)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book ki table mein is peak ko 'doublet' likha hai, magar spectrum quartet dikhata hai aur CH₂ ke saath CH₃ ke teen protons hain. Is liye durust jawab quartet hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
49 A compound C₃H₆O₂ gives two singlets, at 2.0 ppm (3H) and 3.7 ppm (3H). Deduce its structure.
(Compound C₃H₆O₂ do singlets deta hai, 2.0 ppm (3H) aur 3.7 ppm (3H). Is ki structure nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: 2.0 ppm (3H): C=O ke saath CH₃; 3.7 ppm (3H): O ke saath CH₃. Dono singlets, is liye kisi ke parosi protons nahi. Structure: CH₃–CO–O–CH₃ (methyl ethanoate), C₃H₆O₂.

book_ref.quote: Use peak area to find the actual number of hydrogen atoms for each peak

blocks.prompt:
50 Why is ¹²C NMR inactive while ¹³C is NMR active?
(¹²C NMR inactive aur ¹³C NMR active kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: ¹²C mein protons aur neutrons even hain (even mass number), is liye nucleus mein magnetic property nahi: NMR inactive. ¹³C mein neutrons odd hain, is liye magnetic spin hai aur NMR spectra milte hain.

book_ref.quote: and is, therefore, NMR inactive

blocks.prompt:
51 Which solvent is usually used in ¹³C NMR and where does it give a signal?
(¹³C NMR mein aam taur par kaun sa solvent istemal hota hai aur woh kahan signal deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Deuterated chloroform, CDCl₃, aam taur par istemal hota hai. Is ka carbon 77 ppm ke qareeb chhota signal deta hai (77.16 ppm par 1:1:1 triplet).

book_ref.quote: The deuterated chloroform (CDCl₃) is usually used as a solvent which produces a small signal

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book mein 80 ppm likha hai; durust value 77 ppm ke qareeb hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
52 Distinguish between the chemical shift ranges and reference of ¹H NMR and ¹³C NMR.
(¹H NMR aur ¹³C NMR ki chemical shift ranges aur reference mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono TMS ko reference lete hain magar ranges mukhtalif hain:

book_ref.quote: On the basis of the magnetic properties of carbon-13 isotope

blocks.prompt:
53 What decides the environment of a carbon atom? When are two carbons chemically equivalent?
(Carbon atom ka environment kis se tay hota hai? Do carbons kab chemically equivalent hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon atom ka environment us se seedhe jure atoms ki qisam se tay hota hai. Aik environment wale carbons chemically equivalent hain aur aik chemical shift dete hain, maslan ethane ke dono carbons.

book_ref.quote: Carbon atoms that are in the same environment are chemically equivalent

blocks.prompt:
54 How many carbon environments are there in 2-methylpropane? Explain.
(2-methylpropane mein carbon ke kitne environments hain? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Do. Teen methyl carbons aik hi tertiary carbon se jure hain aur un ka environment aik hai; tertiary carbon ka environment mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: while the tertiary carbon has different environment than these three carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
55 Using Table 30.3, give the hybridization and δ range of (i) a carbonyl carbon and (ii) a nitrile carbon.
(Table 30.3 se hybridization aur δ range likhein: (i) carbonyl carbon (ii) nitrile carbon.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Carbonyl carbon (R–CHO, R–CO–R): sp², 190 – 220 ppm. (ii) Nitrile carbon (R–C≡N): sp, 100 – 125 ppm.

book_ref.quote: Table 30.3 Chemical shifts of different carbon environments

blocks.prompt:
56 Differentiate between a carboxyl carbon and a carbonyl carbon in ¹³C NMR.
(¹³C NMR mein carboxyl carbon aur carbonyl carbon mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono sp² carbons hain magar mukhtalif ranges mein aate hain (Table 30.3):

book_ref.quote: The type of environment can be predicted by looking at atoms or bonds around carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
57 Why does ethane show one ¹³C peak while ethanol shows two?
(Ethane aik ¹³C peak aur ethanol do peaks kyun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethane ke dono carbons ka environment aik hai: aik peak. Ethanol (CH₃–CH₂–OH) mein CH₃ carbon aur O se jura CH₂ carbon mukhtalif environments mein hain: do peaks.

book_ref.quote: ¹³C NMR spectrum of ethane shows only one peak as both the carbon atoms have the same environment

blocks.prompt:
58 Assign the two peaks (18 ppm and about 57 ppm) in the ¹³C NMR spectrum of ethanol.
(Ethanol ke ¹³C NMR spectrum ki do peaks (18 ppm aur taqreeban 57 ppm) ki pehchaan karein.)
blocks.explanation: 18 ppm: -CH₃ carbon (alkyl range 0 – 50 ppm). Taqreeban 57 ppm: oxygen se jura -CH₂- carbon (C–O range 50 – 70 ppm).

book_ref.quote: it is evident that the peak at 18 ppm is for -CH₃ carbon

blocks.prompt:
59 Write two differences between ¹H NMR and ¹³C NMR spectra.
(¹H NMR aur ¹³C NMR spectra mein do farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Do bunyadi farq peak area aur splitting mein hain:

book_ref.quote: There are two key differences between ¹H NMR and ¹³C NMR spectra

rows: Peak area protons ki tadaad batata hai
Peak area aam taur par carbon atoms ki tadaad ke mutanasib nahi
Peaks split nahi hoti; seedhi lines ki tarah aati hain

blocks.prompt:
60 Predict the number of ¹³C peaks for (i) butane and (ii) propan-2-ol.
(¹³C peaks ki tadaad predict karein: (i) butane (ii) propan-2-ol.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Butane CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₃: dono kinare ke CH₃ equivalent, dono darmiyani CH₂ equivalent: 2 peaks. (ii) Propan-2-ol (CH₃)₂CHOH: dono CH₃ equivalent, CH–OH mukhtalif: 2 peaks.

book_ref.quote: the middle -CH₂- carbon has a different environment

blocks.prompt:
61 Predict the ¹³C NMR spectrum of propanone (CH₃COCH₃).
(Propanone (CH₃COCH₃) ka ¹³C NMR spectrum predict karein.)
blocks.explanation: Do carbon environments, is liye do peaks: aik dono equivalent CH₃ carbons (carbonyl ke saath) ki aur aik C=O carbon ki, carbonyl range 190 – 220 ppm mein.

book_ref.quote: The ¹³C NMR spectrum is simpler than ¹H NMR

blocks.text: 30.7.3 Determining the Structure of a Molecule from 13C NMR

blocks.prompt:
62 List the steps for working out a structure from a ¹³C NMR spectrum.
(¹³C NMR spectrum se structure nikalne ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Peaks ginein: carbon environments ki tadaad. (2) Table 30.3 ki madad se har peak ki jagah (δ) dekhein ke carbon kis qisam ka hai. (3) Woh mumkina structures banayein jo molecular formula aur peaks ki tadaad aur jagah se milein.

book_ref.quote: The ¹³C NMR a spectrum can be used to figure out a molecule's structure

blocks.prompt:
63 Give reason: butan-1-ol cannot be a C₄H₁₀O compound whose ¹³C spectrum shows only 3 peaks.
(Wajah batayein: butan-1-ol aisa C₄H₁₀O compound nahi ho sakta jis ka ¹³C spectrum sirf 3 peaks de.)
blocks.explanation: Butan-1-ol ke chaaron carbons mukhtalif environments mein hain, is liye 4 peaks mutawaqqa hain. 3 peaks ke liye sirf 3 carbon environments wali structure chahiye.

book_ref.quote: It must be a structure with 3 chemical environments

blocks.prompt:
64 Why do the Figure 30.8 shifts (69.0, 30.5, 19.0 ppm) not fit 2-methoxypropane? Which compound do they fit?
(Figure 30.8 ki shifts (69.0, 30.5, 19.0 ppm) 2-methoxypropane se kyun nahi miltin? Kis compound se milti hain?)
blocks.explanation: 2-methoxypropane, CH₃–O–CH(CH₃)₂, do oxygen wale carbons (taqreeban 56 aur 72 ppm) aur aik 22 ppm ke qareeb deta. Yeh values 2-methylpropan-1-ol, (CH₃)₂CH–CH₂–OH, se milti hain jis mein aik C–O carbon aur teen carbon environments hain.

book_ref.quote: which would give two carbons bonded to oxygen (about 56 and 72 ppm) and one near 22 ppm

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sirf peaks ginna kaafi nahi; peaks ki jagah bhi dekhni chahiye. Do compounds dono 3 peaks dete hain, magar oxygen se jure carbons ki tadaad (50 – 70 ppm wali peaks) un mein farq karti hai.
